rows.grounds: compound of agni, jvālā, and mālikā; subject of the imperative
imperative expressing a wish or command for abiding presence
adverb indicating manifold or repeated presence
pronoun indicating the beneficiary of the invoked presence

items.question: Which fiery garlands are commanded to abide abundantly for the speaker?
premises: Garlands composed of fire-flames are the invoked entities.
These garlands are commanded to stand or remain present.
Their abiding presence is requested abundantly for the speaker.
items.inference: Garlands of fire-flames are to remain abundantly with the speaker.
items.plain_english: And let garlands of fire-flames stand abundantly for me.
